characters.name: Sir Reginald
characters.epithet: Knight of the Order of Moist

leaderSkill.name: Mildly Damp Aura
leaderSkill.desc: Water allies HP x1.8 and ATK x2. Knights gain +1 second move time.

activeSkill.name: Chivalrous Drizzle
activeSkill.desc: Convert Fire orbs to Water orbs and shield the party.

passive.name: Rust-Proof Honor
passive.desc: Water attacks against Fire enemies deal +20% damage.

awakened.epithet: Knight-Commander of the Order of Extremely Moist
awakened.abilityDesc: Chivalrous Drizzle also heals the party. His armor now audibly sloshes with power.

characters.flavor: Took a sacred vow to never be fully dry. Takes it very seriously. Owns forty towels, uses none.

characters.name: Admiral Bathtub

leaderSkill.name: Fleet of One
leaderSkill.desc: Water allies ATK x2.5 when the party contains 3+ elements.

activeSkill.name: Torpedo Quack
activeSkill.desc: Deal massive Water damage to one enemy.

passive.name: Unsinkable
passive.desc: Survives a lethal hit once per battle with 1 HP.

awakened.epithet: Grand Admiral of the Porcelain Sea
awakened.abilityDesc: Torpedo Quack hits all enemies and deploys a visible squadron of tiny ducks.

characters.flavor: A rubber duck who won three naval wars. Historians are furious. The navy is thrilled.

characters.name: Marlene Puddlewitch

leaderSkill.name: Scheduled Precipitation
leaderSkill.desc: Water allies ATK x1.8. Heart orbs appear slightly more often.

activeSkill.name: Permit for Rain
activeSkill.desc: Convert Nature orbs to Water orbs. Form 27-B attached.

characters.flavor: Rain doesn't fall in Glimmerdale without her signature. The clouds learned this the hard way.

characters.name: Gary the Kraken (Junior)

activeSkill.name: Eight-Armed Flurry
activeSkill.desc: Deal Water damage to all enemies eight times. Well, one time, eight-ly.

passive.name: Grabby
passive.desc: 10% chance to delay an enemy when attacking.

characters.flavor: His dad sank armadas. Gary mostly hugs ships until they feel appreciated. HR loves Gary.

characters.name: Soggy Bard Bartholomew

activeSkill.name: Sad Song
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party. The enemies also feel things.

characters.flavor: His lute is waterlogged. His rhymes are waterlogged. His heart? Also waterlogged. It's a whole thing.

characters.name: Splash Nun Agnes

activeSkill.name: Holy Water Balloon
activeSkill.desc: Deal Water damage and cleanse poisoned orbs.

characters.flavor: Baptizes monsters mid-battle whether they consent or not. Conversion rates are astonishing.

characters.name: Suspicious Puddle

activeSkill.name: Lurk
activeSkill.desc: Delay one enemy's action. It stepped in the puddle.

passive.name: Reflective
passive.desc: 5% chance to reflect a small amount of damage.

characters.flavor: Has been following the party for six chapters. Nobody remembers recruiting it. Nobody asks.

characters.name: Cup of Water

activeSkill.name: Sip
activeSkill.desc: Heal one sip of HP. Refreshing.

characters.flavor: Every great hero needs water. This one comes to the battles personally.
